reviewScope: Selected p11-v1, p12-v1, p13-v1, p14-v1 center 1024 cores; native 512x1024 seam crops visually inspected
geometryFindings: No visible broken silhouette or duplicated object on the three first-row seams. Fence rail/post, parasol rim, spokes, and foliage form a coherent continuous strip. This does not assess later row seams or tile boundaries.

issues.description: Subtle straight tonal transition: p13 side is slightly warmer/more saturated yellow. The spokes and outer rim line up; this is a color/material continuity issue rather than a geometric break.
issues.evidence: At the central boundary of the native crop, mean absolute channel jump is 5.263/255 vs 1.344/255 in nearby 32-column band. For tile y512-640, right-minus-left mean RGB is [-3.23,-7.25,-9.98]. Numeric difference is supporting evidence, not a pass/fail threshold.
issues.recommendedAction: Include this exact x2048 parasol band in the tile's later imagegen seam repair/review; preserve current rim and spoke geometry. Inspect against the completed next row before choosing repair extent.

otherSeams.result: No material geometry fault observed; natural foliage/wood texture changes at the cut are small.
Parasol rim/spokes and background vertical timber continue; no concrete repair justified from this crop.

reusableScript: qa_native_seams.py; without arguments audits available selected cores of r03_c10, --all audits all four tiles, always writes only below this QA folder
